title: Builtbyswami Weekly #6: Robotaxis flood Vegas, AI's money moves to the pipes, and Qwen laps Big Tech
teaser: Nevada cleared ~7,000 driverless robotaxis for Las Vegas and Amazon's delivery drones went from 11 metros to nearly 500 towns, while the real AI money quietly moved to infrastructure — Stripe's $7B OpenRouter buy and Nvidia's tangled chip bets. Plus Qwen passing 3 billion downloads, a zero-click VoLTE exploit, and Instagram finally paying for photo posts.
